Build prompt

Rebuild this animation 1:1: Lake's greetings card unlock - pressing a locked day card shrinks it, then it bursts into confetti and flips from the colored cover to the line-art coloring page.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Lake's "Hey!" screen with a SEASON'S GREETINGS row: day cards side by side (a pink floral "5" card already unlocked, a dark green "6 - Free only tomorrow" card), an "Experience Lake in full" upsell banner below.

## Motion spec
Pattern: press-shrink, confetti burst, cover flip, ~1s.
- Touch down on the card: it presses in (scale 1 to 0.94, 120ms, ease-out) with the shadow tightening.
- Release: confetti particles erupt from the card's center (30 to 40 pieces, 600ms, radial burst with gravity and tumble) and drift down over the whole screen.
- On the same beat the card flips on its vertical axis (400ms): colored cover out, monochrome line-art illustration in, the two faces swapping at the 90-degree point.
- The flipped card settles with a tiny bounce (scale 1.03 to 1, spring stiffness 380 damping 15) while the last confetti falls.
- The artist name and card label fade in under the card 100ms after the flip lands.

## Calibration
- The confetti fires at release, before the flip is visible - the burst announces the unlock, the flip delivers it.
- Confetti falls over everything, including the upsell banner - it is a screen-level layer, not clipped to the card.

## Reduced motion
Card crossfades to the illustration; no confetti.

## Don't miss
- The press shrink is the anticipation beat - skipping it makes the burst feel unearned.
- The illustration is the same art as the cover, line-art version - the flip must read as "now you can color it," not a different card.
